defs.def: a person whose job is designing buildings, etc. 建筑师

ex.s: “I am the last original client of Frank Lloyd Wright, still living in the home he designed for me,” Reisley said, sitting in the bright open living room of the home designed by the famous architect.
ex.t: “我是弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特最后一位健在的原始客户，至今仍住在他为我设计的房子里，”Reisley坐在由这位著名建筑师设计的明亮通透的客厅里说道。

ex.s: This old castle is said ____ from designs by a famous architect in the 16th century.
ex.t: 据说这座古老的城堡是根据16世纪一位著名建筑师的设计____建造的。

ex.s: Discover how architects, product designers and scientists use similar skills in their work.

ex.t: 事实上很多更小的孩子口袋里也装着一个。

ex.s: They were designed by Giles Gilbert Scott the architect of the Battersea Power Station in London.
ex.t: 原始的圆顶铁制电话亭首次出现于1926年。

ex.s: While famous foreign architects are invited to lead the designs of landmark buildings in China such as the new CCTV tower and the National Center for the Performing Arts, many excellent Chinese architects are making great efforts to take the center stage.
Wang Shu, a 49-year-old Chinese architect, won the 2012 Pritzker Architecture Prize — which is often referred to as the Nobel Prize in architecture — on February 28.
Wang’s winning of the prize means that Chinese architects are ___________.
ex.t: 不知不觉一个小时过去了，该去吃午饭了。

ex.s: working harder than ever before       D. relying on foreign architects
ex.t: 他得到了我全部的注意力，我也得到了他的。

defs.def: a person who is responsible for planning or creating an idea, an event or a situation 设计师；缔造者；创造者

ex.s: Today, architects continue to explore ways to capture the beauty of natural forms, to mimic the way nature works or even to make natural organisms part of a building.
ex.t: 如今，建筑师们继续探索如何捕捉自然形态的美，模仿自然的运作方式，甚至让自然生物成为建筑的一部分。

ex.s: Zimbabwean architect Mick Pearce was inspired to create the Centre while watching a nature documentary in which termites were constructing their nests.
ex.t: 津巴布韦建筑师米克·皮尔斯在看一部白蚁筑巢的自然纪录片时受到启发，从而设计了这个中心。

ex.s: Review: non-finite forms as subject, object and predicative a Today, architects continue to explore ways to capture the beauty of natural forms, … b … it appears to float above the waterfront promenade and the water that surrounds it.
ex.t: 复习：非谓语形式作主语、宾语和表语 a 如今，建筑师们继续探索如何捕捉自然形态的美……b……它似乎漂浮在海滨步道和环绕它的水面之上。

ex.s: It was designed by Catalan architect Antoni Gaudí and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
ex.t: 它由加泰罗尼亚建筑师安东尼·高迪设计，是联合国教科文组织世界遗产地。

ex.s: Mr Li is an architect whose designs for the new town have won praise.
ex.t: 李先生是一名建筑师，他为新城镇所做的设计赢得了赞誉。
